contracts.blurb: A neighbouring council uses your depot system to stock its clinics, paid per month.
Your revenue clerks train new clerks on e-ticket kiosks, paid per course.
Your waste timetable runs in their capital, paid per route.
A health fund pays you to run drug deliveries for 40 health centres.
Ghanaian councils license your open budget template.
An exchange of sanitation crews and ideas, paid per visit.

belt.name: Cargo Keke Runner
belt.blurb: Carries supplies from the yard to the nearest service points without you.

auto.name: E-Ticket Kiosk Line
auto.blurb: Logs every fee so no naira goes missing between the gate and the treasury.

pack.name: Compactor Fleet and Hub
pack.blurb: Trucks restock all five service points and clear waste routes on a timetable.

milestones.title: Second Council
milestones.blurb: Ifeso council copies your posted budget and depot.

milestones.title: Five Councils
milestones.blurb: Five councils pay salaries on time and post their books.

milestones.title: Half of Marobi
milestones.blurb: Nine councils share one drug depot and one waste timetable.

milestones.title: Across States
milestones.blurb: Councils in Edun and Ogaji States run the Okele system.

milestones.title: Open Data Wall
milestones.blurb: Every clinic, school and bin route shows live on a public screen.

milestones.title: Peer Visits
milestones.blurb: Teams from other states and countries come to learn.

milestones.title: Clean Audits Everywhere
milestones.blurb: Five years of clean audits in every council you serve.

milestones.title: A Town That Works
milestones.blurb: Stocked clinics, full classrooms, clean streets. Mama Risi smiles.

staff: Drug cartons for the health centre, coming!
Ticket rolls loaded at the market desk.
Textbooks for Primary 4, counted and stamped.
Gutter on Market Road is clear.
Asphalt bags ready for the park gate.
Every payment is in the ledger.
Birth certificate printed, free of charge.
Pothole by the keke stand is patched.
Budget notice is up on the gate.
customer: The clinic has drugs again. Thank you!
Where can I register my baby's birth?
The gutter no flood this time!
When does the bin truck come to our street?
Can I see what my levy paid for?
My son has his own textbook now.
The park road is smooth. Well done.
I read the budget on my phone.
Please, the light at the market gate.
manager: Keep a reserve for the lean months.
The auditor is our friend. Show her everything.
Post the budget, people will pay.
Approval is earned in queues, not speeches.
night: Papa Garba kept the stew warm.
Tomorrow: clinic shelves and the park road.
The ward is quiet. The gutters are clear.
Mama Risi called: write am down, my daughter.
Sleep well. Allocation day is coming.

events.name: Gutter Flood
events.text: Heavy rain blocks the market gutter. Fewer traders open until the crew clears it.

events.name: Town Hall Praise
events.text: Residents clap at the town hall. More people come to pay fees today.

events.name: Truck Breakdown
events.text: The refuse truck will not start. Supplies move slowly today.

events.name: Pothole Season
events.text: Rain opens new potholes at the motor park. Repairs cost extra today.

events.name: Budget Goes Viral
events.text: A resident shares your posted budget online. Everyone wants to see the council that shows its work.

events.name: Free Drug Donation
events.text: A health charity donates malaria drugs. The clinic serves faster today.

events.name: State Health Grant
events.text: A primary health grant arrives in the council account for the clinics.

events.name: Market Day
events.text: Big market day in Okele. Traders and buyers fill every lane.

mech.name: Hand carry
mech.how: Drug cartons and ticket rolls carried from the depot in both arms

mech.name: Wheelbarrow
mech.how: A council wheelbarrow rolls asphalt bags and books along the yard

mech.name: Cargo keke
mech.how: Teal three-wheeler with a flat cargo bed brings crates to the nearest points

mech.name: Council pickup
mech.how: White pickup with the council crest parks at the depot, crates move in

mech.name: Depot forklift
mech.how: Small forklift lifts pallets of drugs and books into the state depot

mech.name: Compactor fleet
mech.how: White compactor trucks with teal stripes run every route on a timetable

storyNote: Story follows plan2/council.json. No bribery, vote buying, rigging or fraud scenes exist: elections are won only by service and approval. Places and teams are invented; no real parties or politicians.
